description: Defaults to the latest reporting build for the selected game/environment, across sources. Historical builds remain selectable. Panels respect the selected time range and source unless labeled global.

targets.rawSql: SELECT avgOrNull(JSONExtractInt(properties,'turn')) AS destruction_turn, avgOrNull(JSONExtractInt(properties,'remaining')) AS remaining_enemies FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND build_version=if(${build_version:sqlstring}='__latest__', (SELECT build_version FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} GROUP BY build_version ORDER BY max(timestamp) DESC, build_version DESC LIMIT 1), ${build_version:sqlstring}) AND source_type=${source_type:sqlstring} AND (event_name='obelisk_destroyed')

SELECT count() AS battles FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND build_version=if(${build_version:sqlstring}='__latest__', (SELECT build_version FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} GROUP BY build_version ORDER BY max(timestamp) DESC, build_version DESC LIMIT 1), ${build_version:sqlstring}) AND source_type=${source_type:sqlstring} AND (event_name='encounter_completed' AND schema_version=2)

SELECT JSONExtractString(properties,'card_name') AS card, count() AS plays FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND build_version=if(${build_version:sqlstring}='__latest__', (SELECT build_version FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} GROUP BY build_version ORDER BY max(timestamp) DESC, build_version DESC LIMIT 1), ${build_version:sqlstring}) AND source_type=${source_type:sqlstring} AND (event_name='card_played') GROUP BY card ORDER BY plays DESC, card LIMIT 20

SELECT $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time, JSONExtractString(properties,'encounter') AS encounter, avg(JSONExtractInt(properties,'damage_taken')) AS health_damage FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND build_version=if(${build_version:sqlstring}='__latest__', (SELECT build_version FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} GROUP BY build_version ORDER BY max(timestamp) DESC, build_version DESC LIMIT 1), ${build_version:sqlstring}) AND source_type=${source_type:sqlstring} AND (event_name='encounter_completed' AND schema_version=2) GROUP BY time, encounter ORDER BY time, encounter

panels.description: V2 only: damage, net loss and healing have distinct meanings. V1 lacks these metrics.

targets.rawSql: SELECT JSONExtractString(properties,'encounter') AS encounter, count() AS battles, avg(JSONExtractInt(properties,'turns')) AS turns, avg(JSONExtractInt(properties,'damage_taken')) AS health_damage, avg(JSONExtractInt(properties,'net_health_loss')) AS net_health_loss, avg(JSONExtractInt(properties,'healing_received')) AS healing FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND build_version=if(${build_version:sqlstring}='__latest__', (SELECT build_version FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} GROUP BY build_version ORDER BY max(timestamp) DESC, build_version DESC LIMIT 1), ${build_version:sqlstring}) AND source_type=${source_type:sqlstring} AND (event_name='encounter_completed' AND schema_version=2) GROUP BY encounter ORDER BY battles DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Encounter damage and healing detail (v2)

list.name: game_id
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT game_id FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated ORDER BY game_id

list.name: environment
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT environment FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated ORDER BY environment

list.description: Latest event timestamp for this game/environment, across sources and outside the time picker. Select a version to pin history.
list.label: Build
list.name: build_version
list.query: SELECT '__latest__' AS __value, 'Latest reporting build' AS __text UNION ALL SELECT build_version AS __value, build_version AS __text FROM (SELECT build_version, max(timestamp) AS last_seen FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} GROUP BY build_version ORDER BY last_seen DESC, build_version DESC)

list.name: source_type
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT source_type FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated ORDER BY source_type
